title: Audio system: playback interface, gapless phoneme sequencing, ducking rules, recording brief (Unit 13 app half)
accept: AudioService interface: play(audioRef) by opaque source-agnostic ref, stop, completion futures/streams, and channel tagging (help, narration, celebration, ambient) for ducking; FakeAudioService records an ordered log of play/stop/duck calls with fake-clock timing so every downstream ticket (scaffold, reading screen, vocab, celebration, twister) can assert audio behavior headlessly.

PhonemeSequencer plays a word's phoneme audio sequence ('kuh… aah… tuh') gaplessly in graphemePhonemeMap order, emitting a per-phoneme started event carrying the map index (the reading screen's grapheme-highlight sync point); order and events asserted for digraph and silent-e fixture words ('ship', 'cake').

Ducking rules pinned and tested as a pure policy: help audio ducks ambient/celebration audio; NOTHING ducks the microphone processing (the policy has no interaction with the listening pipeline — asserted by API absence and a test that help audio during 'listening' issues no mic-affecting command).
Nothing is generated at runtime: the service only plays shipped refs; there is no TTS code path (asserted by API shape).

[DEVICE] Phoneme sequence playback latency < 150 ms from trigger on min-spec device (A-6) — owner-measured in profile mode, recorded in repo; headless proxy: the sequencer issues its first play command synchronously (same event-loop turn) from trigger under fake_async (test).

docs/audio/recording-brief.md transcribes the pinned recording direction for the owner's narrator sessions: one narrator throughout; fixed sets = 44 phonemes (clean articulation, minimal schwa tail), ~10 celebration lines, fixed prompts ('your turn'); plus sentence narrations, tongue twisters, per-story word pronunciations, vocab definition read-alouds; all normalized to -16 LUFS integrated by the pipeline.
[DEVICE] Product-owner sign-off on the recorded phoneme set — owner deliverable, tracked in notes, not testable here.
pinned_design: Unit 13 pinned: all v1 voice audio is human-recorded, supplied by the product owner, one narrator throughout (ratified, OQ-3): 44 phonemes with clean articulation and minimal schwa (recording brief is part of this unit), ~10 celebration lines, fixed prompts, sentence narrations, twisters, word pronunciations, definition read-alouds — ingested and loudness-normalized by the pipeline (Unit 3 owns the -16 LUFS check); nothing generated at runtime. TTS is a post-v1 alternative only: the audio manifest is source-agnostic (a pronunciation is just an audio ref) so TTS can later substitute without app changes — therefore this service takes opaque refs. Playback engine pinned requirements: low-latency (phoneme sound-out must feel instant), gapless sequential phoneme playback, ducking rules (help audio ducks ambient/celebration; nothing ducks microphone processing).
notes: PUBSPEC BLOCKER for the real implementation: the pinned pubspec has NO audio playback plugin — the orchestrator must centrally add one (e.g. just_audio or audioplayers; see OPEN-DECISIONS) and the concrete impl is a thin adapter behind AudioService, owner-verified on device. Everything in this ticket is interface + pure logic + fake, fully headless; no real audio files exist in the container (tests reference refs only). Latency and phoneme-set sign-off acceptance are [DEVICE]/owner.
